name: San Bernardino County Auditor-Controller/Treasurer/Tax Collector
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public sbcountyatc.gov pages (JavaScript site rendered headlessly, FAQ accordions expanded; no sign-in, no lookup). Pay online at Pay Property Tax Online; checking/savings free; cards 2.30% (minimum $1.95) since Sept 15, 2025; commercial/international cards 3.95% (minimum $1.95); in-office debit $2.95. Phone (909) 387-8308 takes cards or checking/savings. Mail to 268 West Hospitality Lane, First Floor, San Bernardino, CA 92415. Partial Payment Program lets owners pay secured taxes in smaller amounts (late installments get the 10% penalty on the unpaid balance). Payment plans other than the printed due dates only under certain conditions by calling a tax specialist, so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. Payment history dashboard exists; the site describes no e-bill or automatic payment program (inferred unsupported). Email sign-in is synthetic.

help.title: Ways to pay your property tax bill
paragraphs: Pay online at Pay Property Tax Online (instant confirmation, available 24/7). Paying from a checking or savings account is free; card fees are listed in the card fee article.

By phone, call (909) 387-8308 and pay with Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, or a checking or savings account. By mail, send your payment with the tax bill (or your parcel number written on the check) to Auditor-Controller/Treasurer/Tax Collector, 268 West Hospitality Lane, First Floor, San Bernardino, CA 92415. Checks must be in U.S. dollars from a U.S. bank account. You can also pay in person at the same address.
Because of rising mail theft and check fraud, the office recommends paying online instead of mailing checks.

help.title: Card payment fees
paragraphs: Since September 15, 2025, debit and credit card payments cost 2.30% with a minimum fee of $1.95; commercial and international credit cards cost 3.95% with the same $1.95 minimum. The processor sets the fee and shows it before you pay. Paying from a checking or savings account is free. Debit card payments in the office cost $2.95.

help.title: Partial Payment Option
paragraphs: The Partial Payment Program lets you pay your secured property taxes in smaller amounts that fit your budget, which helps reduce penalties and interest and keep your taxes current.
Any amount still unpaid on an installment's delinquency date is charged the usual penalty, so plan your partial payments to cover each installment in time.

help.title: Late payments and penalties
paragraphs: Late taxes generally get a 10% penalty on the amount owed. Taxes that go into default add costs and penalties of 1.5% a month. A payment is on time if it is received or postmarked by the delinquency date; a payment received late without a postmark is late.

Not receiving a tax bill does not remove penalties. Print a duplicate bill from the website or call (909) 387-8308. Under certain conditions a payment plan can be arranged; ask a tax specialist at the same number.
